title: Make thumbnail/tooltip popup resizable by dragging on edges, as with traditional windows and many other Plasma popups
line: Task Manager tooltips with window thumbnails can now be resized by dragging their edges, and keep their new size.
explanation: The task tooltip's size was fixed in QML (16 grid units per window, 8 for the thumbnail height) and the tooltip window has no resize handling of its own, since it always takes its content's implicit size. The change adds thin drag areas over the tooltip's edges that don't face the panel; dragging them changes the window width and thumbnail height, which are stored in two new task manager config keys (toolTipWidth, toolTipThumbnailHeight; 0 = default). Along the panel the dragged edge follows the pointer exactly, accounting for the tooltip being centered on its task, clamped at the screen edge, and for group tooltips listing several windows.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: make thumbnail tooltips resizable from their edges

Window thumbnails in task tooltips had a fixed size, too small to see much
on many screens. Dragging any edge not facing the panel now resizes the
tooltip like Kickoff and the system tray, and the size is remembered.

BUG: 526187

media.caption: Master: Dolphin's tooltip after dragging its top edge up to the middle of the screen: nothing happens, the thumbnail stays small
With the change: the top and right edges were dragged and the thumbnail is much larger; the size is kept for every window tooltip and after restarting Plasma
Group tooltip with two Konsole windows uses the same remembered size; dragging its right edge shrinks both windows and the edge stays under the pointer

review.text: The feature works per the media, but it adds about 80 lines of hand-made QML edge MouseAreas that recompute the window size from pointer math (centering, screen clamping, group counts) and write config on every mouse move. libplasma already has WindowResizeHandler (used by AppletPopup), which handles edge resizing natively with the edges facing the panel excluded. That's the 'like Kickoff and the system tray' behaviour the commit message promises, but ToolTipDialog doesn't offer it. Maintainers will likely want the tooltip window to get that ability in libplasma, not a task-manager-only reimplementation that's hard to maintain.
changes: libplasma: add an opt-in resizable mode to ToolTipDialog/ToolTipArea that reuses WindowResizeHandler with active edges = ~nearbyBorders(), and reports the user-chosen size

plasma-desktop task manager: enable it only for thumbnail tooltips and derive/store toolTipWidth and toolTipThumbnailHeight from the reported size (write once at the end of the resize, not on every move)
Drop the QML ResizeHandle component and its pointer math
